verdict.rationale: Puzzle documents batch/bulk-style operations such as 'Batch Categorize Transactions', custom categorization rules applied across transactions, and AI Close which uses AI agents to reconcile accounts and review transactions in bulk during month-end. These show real bulk-operation support but the evidence is limited to categorization/close workflows rather than a general-purpose bulk-action framework across arbitrary item types. missing for 10: broader bulk-edit capabilities beyond categorization/close (e.g. bulk invoice edits, bulk journal entries), independent/hands-on verification of batch performance at scale
